subject.title: docs: note LanceDB dreaming v0.2.3 via memory-lancedb-dreaming plugin

question: Should OpenClaw core docs include a generic LanceDB/vector-native Dreaming caveat, or should all `memory-lancedb-dreaming` package/version availability stay only on ClawHub?
rationale: The exact issue request is package/version promotion, which VISION.md routes to ClawHub, but current docs are also stale relative to the slot-owned Dreaming config behavior and the open linked PR proposes a generic clarification.

options.title: Accept generic docs clarification
options.body: Have the linked PR keep package-specific promotion out of core docs while documenting the active memory-slot owner contract and ClawHub discovery path.

options.title: Keep availability on ClawHub only
options.body: Close or redirect the linked PR and leave plugin package/version details to ClawHub pages and the plugin's own docs.

recommendation.title: Accept generic docs clarification
recommendation.body: Have the linked PR keep package-specific promotion out of core docs while documenting the active memory-slot owner contract and ClawHub discovery path.
